hero.title: 🚀 Streamline Your Meeting Notes
hero.description: Stop hunting through scattered notes. Neetings transforms your meetings into productive workflows with intelligent organization - all running 100% in your browser.
hero.termsAgreement: By using this service, you agree to our

confluence.question: 🔗 Does Neetings work with Confluence™?
confluence.answer: Absolutely! 📋 Download your meeting series as Markdown, copy the content to your clipboard, and paste it directly into Confluence™. ✨ Your structured blocks, formatting, and organization transfer seamlessly! 🚀

whyChoose.question: Why choose Neetings over traditional note-taking apps?
whyChoose.answer: Stop fighting with generic text boxes! Neetings provides 11 specialized block types (Stories, TODOs, Decisions, Issues, etc.) that understand your meeting content. Plus, instant Kanban view, smart attendee tracking, and powerful filtering - all running 100% in your browser with zero setup.

security.question: Is my meeting data secure and private?
security.answer: Yes, your data never leaves your device. Neetings stores everything in your browser's localStorage - no backend servers, no data collection, no cloud sync. You maintain complete control and can export your data anytime as JSON files.

quickStart.question: How quickly can I get started?
quickStart.answer: Literally 30 seconds! Try our live demo instantly with no installation, or run locally with just 'npm install && npm run dev'. Create your first meeting, add some blocks, and experience the difference immediately.

blockSystem.question: What makes the block system so powerful?
blockSystem.answer: Each content type gets its own intelligent structure: TODOs have completion tracking, Q&As have separate question/answer fields, Research blocks track topics and results. No more forcing everything into plain text - your content gets the structure it deserves.

organization.question: Can I organize complex meetings effectively?
organization.answer: Yes! Switch to Kanban view to organize blocks into topic columns. Drag and drop between topics as discussions evolve. Use advanced filtering to find specific content types, completion status, or date ranges. Perfect for multi-topic meetings and sprint planning.

attendees.question: How does attendee management work?
attendees.answer: Smart autocomplete by name or email, global attendee registry across all meetings, visual participation tracking, and one-click assignment. See who attends which meetings and track engagement patterns over time.

teamSize.question: Is Neetings suitable for my team size and use case?
teamSize.answer: Neetings works well for various team sizes and use cases: team leads managing projects, product managers tracking decisions, consultants organizing client meetings, agile teams running sprints, or anyone managing meeting notes. Suitable for individual users to large organizations.

dataPortability.question: What about data portability and backups?
dataPortability.answer: Export all your meetings as JSON files anytime. Import/export for easy backups, cross-device sync via file transfer, and zero vendor lock-in. You maintain complete control over your data.

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing
dataProcessing.content: Under the current technical design, meeting content entered into Neetings is processed exclusively in the user's browser and is not transmitted to the provider or any third party unless the user independently exports or shares it outside Neetings. When the website is accessed, technically necessary connection and access data is generated, including, for example, the IP address and the time and subject of the relevant request. Further details are provided in the Privacy Policy.

localStorage.title: Local Data Storage
localStorage.content: Meeting content is stored exclusively in the local storage of the browser being used. Neetings does not provide server-side synchronisation or backups of this content. Locally stored content may be lost, in particular, if browser data is deleted, private browsing mode is used, the user changes browser or device, a technical fault occurs, or the device is lost. Users should therefore regularly back up their content using the available export functions. The provider generally has no access to locally stored meeting content and cannot restore lost content.

noCookies.title: Cookies and Local Browser Storage
noCookies.content: Under the current technical design, Neetings does not use cookies, tracking pixels, or web analytics services. Neetings uses the browser's local storage to provide the local storage and availability of meeting content expressly requested by the user.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Information about the processing of technically necessary connection and access data, hosting, possible recipients, retention periods, and data subject rights is provided in the separate Privacy Policy. These Terms of Service do not replace the Privacy Policy.

serviceAvailability.title: Scope, Contract Formation, and Availability
serviceAvailability.content: These Terms of Service apply to the free use of the Neetings web application. Information about the provider is available in the Legal Notice. The user agreement is formed when, after being informed of these Terms of Service, the user clicks the “Start Meeting Series” button. There is no entitlement to enter into a user agreement or to any particular availability, uptime, or continued provision of the service. The provider may temporarily restrict or interrupt the service, in particular due to maintenance, security issues, technical faults, or circumstances beyond its control. Features may be developed, modified, or discontinued, provided that users are not thereby unreasonably disadvantaged. Any complete discontinuation of the service will be announced on the website in advance where possible and reasonable. Users may stop using the service at any time.

noSupport.title: No Support Obligation
noSupport.content: Users are not entitled to individual technical support, bug fixes, updates, or the development of particular features. If the provider voluntarily supplies support, updates, or improvements, this does not create any entitlement to equivalent services in the future.

asIs.title: Scope of Service
asIs.content: Neetings enables users to create and organise meeting notes in their browser, store them locally, and export them using the available functions. The provider is obliged to supply only the functions described on the website. No particular commercial, organisational, or other outcome is owed. Neetings is not represented as being fully compatible with every device, operating system, or browser. Users' mandatory statutory rights remain unaffected.

liability.title: Liability
liability.content: The provider has unlimited liability for damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence and for damage resulting from injury to life, limb, or health. In the event of a slightly negligent breach of a material contractual obligation, liability is limited to the loss that is typical for the contract and reasonably foreseeable. Material contractual obligations are obligations whose performance is essential for the proper performance of the agreement and on whose performance users may ordinarily rely. In all other respects, liability is excluded to the extent permitted by law. Mandatory statutory liability, including liability under the German Product Liability Act, remains unaffected. These limitations of liability apply accordingly for the benefit of the provider's legal representatives and agents.

userResponsibility.title: User Responsibility and Rights in Content
userResponsibility.content: Neetings may be used only in accordance with applicable law. In particular, users must not use the service to disrupt, damage, or place an abusive load on the website or its technical infrastructure. Users retain all rights they hold in their meeting content. Because this content is processed exclusively locally, users do not grant the provider any rights to use it. Users are responsible for regularly backing up their locally stored content. Statutory liability claims remain unaffected.

changes.title: Changes and Governing Law
changes.content: The provider may amend these Terms of Service with effect for the future where this is necessary due to legal, technical, or functional developments and users are not thereby unreasonably disadvantaged. Users will be clearly informed of material changes before their next use of the service. Where a change materially affects an existing contractual relationship, it will take effect only if the user agrees to it through an express action. Mere continued use or silence does not constitute consent. The laws of the Federal Republic of Germany apply, excluding the United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. For consumers, this choice of law applies only to the extent that it does not deprive them of the protection afforded by mandatory provisions of the country in which they habitually reside.
